platform.title: Hosting platform
platform.description: Auto-detects from the remote host by default; pick a platform for self-hosted domains or Custom to use the URL templates below.

remoteName.title: Preferred remote name
remoteName.description: Remote used when the current branch has no upstream (falls back to the first configured remote if missing).

fallbackBranch.title: Fallback branch
fallbackBranch.description: Branch used when HEAD is detached or unpushed and no branch name is available.

checkCommitOnRemote.title: Fall back to branch when HEAD has unpushed commits
checkCommitOnRemote.description: Uses a commit SHA permalink when HEAD is pushed to its upstream, and the branch name when HEAD is ahead of upstream or has no upstream.

forceHttps.title: Use HTTPS URLs
forceHttps.description: Generates https:// links even when the remote URL uses http://.

hostAliases.title: SSH / custom host aliases
hostAliases.description: Comma- or newline-separated alias=hostname mappings (e.g. github-personal=github.com, gitlab-work=gitlab.com). Overrides ~/.ssh/config.

customFileAtCommitTemplate.title: Custom template: file at commit
customFileAtCommitTemplate.description: Same placeholders as file at branch, plus {commit} and {commit:short}.
